summary: Preserve the attention future-acceptance fence across unread backlogs

replay.detail: No claim ordering or replay changes.

schema.detail: Read-only query change; no persisted schema, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: Unread kinds and complete publication cuts remain unchanged. Future acceptance times continue to include unread claims.

compatibility.detail: The future-acceptance helper now applies its 10000-claim fallback limit to potentially relevant claims, rather than the raw index span. A backlog of exactly10001 unread claims retains its future fence instead of silently falling back to the periodic clock. The relevant count stops at10001 rows.

downtime.detail: Normal binary restart only; no backfill.

manual.detail: No operator steps or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback; authoritative data is unchanged.
